messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Executive Profile | Corporate Affairs, Government Relations & Strategy
messages.body:
Dear Al-Dawaa Recruitment Team,

I am sharing my executive profile for senior opportunities in Saudi Arabia across corporate and external affairs, government relations, ESG and sustainability, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive operations.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance, executive communications and cross-functional execution within a major multinational operation.

Al-Dawaa's national footprint and regulated operating environment align with my experience managing institutional relationships, public-sector interfaces, compliance-sensitive matters and enterprise stakeholder priorities.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and country-facing leadership mandates across Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. My Saudi/GCC executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile, available with 30 days notice and open to employer-supported relocation.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc. (Zijin Mining Group)
